name: Kyber Cursor
author: s3pp3ku
description: A theme-colored blade cursor that ignites when you hold a button, with crossguard beams and a fading drag trail.

barWidget.description: Choose the cursor color and adjust its appearance. Click to change the options.

schema.label: Glow color source
schema.description: theme: follow the Omarchy accent; custom: your own color; random: a new vivid color at each theme change and boot.

schema.label: Custom glow color
schema.description: A hex color such as #ff7a00. Setting one switches the source to custom.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: all: ignite and off sounds; ignite: ignite only; mute: no sound.
